final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and instead reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is useful and reduces the overbreadth of the claim, but it does not satisfy the missing compliance predicate. Under the provided policy text, when the affected use case remains exposed, compliance requires either explicit disclosure of the material limitation or reviewed risk acceptance. The record still does not contain evidence that final model-card disclosure was completed and approved before launch, and it affirmatively indicates the risk-acceptance path is unsigned and incomplete. That means the issue is not merely a caveat in wording; it is an unresolved policy condition. A caveated certification could become supportable if the disclosure artifact were actually shown, but on the current admissible record the claim remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
